meta.name: AirConditioner
meta.description: Air conditioner. It supports cooling, heating, fan, dehumidification, and automatic modes. Users can query and set the operating mode, target temperature, fan speed, swing direction, sleep mode, and auxiliary-heating state, and can incrementally raise or lower the target temperature. Target temperature is available only in operating modes that regulate temperature; temperature cannot be set in dehumidification mode; auxiliary heating is available only in modes that require heating and turns off after the room reaches the target temperature. While running, the device adjusts the temperature or humidity of its space according to the current operating mode; fan-only operation does not directly change temperature or humidity.

Before replacing progress_minutes, calculate actually traversed cleaning minutes as max(0, min(new progress,30)-min(previous progress_minutes,30)) for a cleaning mode, or zero in recharge mode. Increase vacuum_cleaned_units by those minutes times suction_level in vacuum or vacuum_and_mop mode, and increase mopped_units by those minutes times mopping_water_level in mop or vacuum_and_mop mode. These internal outputs quantify the most recent run on its selected cleaning_area; they are not Space properties. Thus water has no cleaning effect in vacuum mode, and an action that skips cleaning produces no fabricated cleaning output. Persist the new progress, set remaining_minutes=total-progress, and select phases at their exact cumulative duration boundaries. At the final boundary set status and phase to completed and remaining_minutes=0. Set base_state to the phase during dust_collection, mop_washing or drying, otherwise idle. Paused and unpowered processes do not advance or change cleaning outputs. After processing, return one absolute set_contribution effect to the containing Home Space noise property, unit dBA: while powered and running, cleaning is 20+5*suction_level dBA for vacuum-containing modes or 20 for mop-only, returning is 20, dust_collection is 45, mop_washing is 25, drying is 15, and charging is zero. All idle, completed, paused or unpowered states contribute zero; always emit zero to clear stale output. Emit this Space noise effect only on tick.

tick.description: During powered running motion, let progress_minutes be the current elapsed world minute minus started_at_minute, clamped to [0, travel_minutes]. Set opening_percentage to start_opening_percentage plus or minus min(distance, abs(target_opening_percentage-start_opening_percentage)), using motion_mode for direction. Set remaining_minutes=travel_minutes-progress_minutes. At progress_minutes=travel_minutes set opening_percentage exactly to target_opening_percentage, status and phase to completed, and remaining_minutes=0. Idle, paused, completed and unpowered motion preserves its persisted progress and position. After that update, a nonzero opening physically exchanges indoor and outdoor environments even when the motor is unpowered. For each minute, let fraction=opening_percentage/100 and emit only delta effects to the containing Home Space: temperature delta=round(0.05*fraction*(outdoor_temperature-Space temperature), 1) degC; humidity delta=round(0.05*fraction*(outdoor_humidity-Space humidity)) %RH; air_quality delta=round(0.10*fraction*(outdoor_air_quality-Space air_quality)) AQI.
